verified: Crew's packaged register_app registers nothing for an untrusted third-party app.
A manifest stdio entry {command: python3, args: [mcp/server.py]} is rewritten to the gateway interpreter, -s, and the launcher's real path under the installed app root.
The x-kirocrew-session-label marker and per-server static env survive registration.
Crew's packaged session-label builder emits one per-session element only for the server the agent's tools grant, with KIROCREW_SESSION_LABEL set last to the session key.
An mcpServers entry declared inside an agent file is copied unresolved (bare interpreter, relative launcher), so it is not a portable way to vary env per agent.
Over real MCP stdio the reference server exposes the exact room catalog only when label, profile room and backend binding agree, and nothing otherwise.
Tool arguments, _meta and process cwd cannot select session, Ghost, Mansion or Room.

kiro-cli 3.3.0, driven directly over ACP with no prompt (one run by the team lead, recorded under kiroCliDirectObservation): a session/new stdio element is started at session/new, receives its declared env including KIROCREW_SESSION_LABEL, also inherits kiro-cli's own environment, and starts in the session cwd.

guidance.binding: The backend picks an unguessable slot name, writes the owner-only binding record for dashboard:<slot> under <app-root>/data before sending the first turn, and removes it when the session ends.
guidance.manifest: Declare one stdio server per room (room-archivist, room-draughtsman, room-foreman, room-tinker), each {command: python3, args: [mcp/server.py], env: {HH_ROOM: <room>}, x-kirocrew-session-label: true}. No autoApprove, no ${...} or secret:// env values: either one silently withholds the label.
guidance.profiles: Each Ghost profile lists exact @haunted-house:room-<room>/<tool> selectors for its own room server only, allowedTools [], and no mcpServers block of its own.
guidance.server: Derive app root from the launcher's real path, session from KIROCREW_SESSION_LABEL, room from HH_ROOM, and Ghost/Mansion/spec from the binding. Never read cwd, tool arguments or _meta for authority, and trust no environment variable other than the Crew-set label and HH_ROOM: the process also inherits kiro-cli's own environment. List no tools when any input is missing or disagrees, and report the Ghost blocked.
